cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

mechanism: A modestly offers to drive while deciding cancellations, departure and payment, encouraging B birthday choice through increasing fury at the cost.
confusable: Not withdrawing support or mere reluctant acquiescence: A controls practical arrangements so B still gets the desired celebration.
comparison: Paint loss and immediate practical help versus financial loss and birthday encouragement.
